mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 30 degrees with a wind chill making it feel like 24 under clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail.

The city has announced pavement repairs for Tuesday, November 10 and Wednesday, November 11. Crews will be milling and patching several locations including Nine Mound Road and Mozart Street, with no parking enforced from 7 AM until 7 PM.
There is plenty to do, including the Dane County Farmers Market happening today at the Wisconsin State Capitol, plus live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's throughout today.
In a noteworthy call from Sunday, October 25, officers arrested a man for his first offence of O W I after finding him passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton and Rita.
Today's flavor of the day is Andes Mint Avalanche. The store is currently closed, but will open today at 10:00 AM for you to enjoy your treat.
